title: Transport normalized external evaluations to both native coefficient cones
statement: Use [def-pur-external-rhom-pairing-interface]. Fix a coherent integer-shift structure S on every native contravariant homFirst(X,K), and assume HasSignedHomShift for this S, including target-map naturality and the evaluation-normalized leftUnshift representative identity. Then PreservesCoefficientCones holds for this same S: for bounded-below K,L and their bounded-below external tensor F, and bounded-flat-representable coefficient triangles, both native image triangles are distinguished and the prescribed three pairing components form a triangle morphism in either coefficient. This asserts transport to the native image triangles and their connecting squares, not construction of S or any of the extracted cochain identities.

source.place: Tags 08J9, 08JA, 08JB, 08JC, 0A90 and 0G7D; the indicated part of the external global-Hom evaluation argument.

proof.text: Apply the existing global Hom evaluation flat lifts on both sites. The existing lifted external chain-model lemma identifies every chosen normalized chain pairing with the native pairing, and its shifted-lift clause keeps the two target lifts and their external K-injective target unchanged.

Apply the existing two-shift-squares theorem on the constant-ring realization of P. Transport its E identity (sign sq+s) and H identity (sign sq+q+r) through the canonical scalar-realization tensor and Hom comparisons. Cancel the localized source and target model isomorphisms. The prescribed normalization of S and its naturality in target maps identify the resulting equations with the native pairing shift squares, including the canonical opposite shift comparison.

Internal Hom into a K-injective takes a reversed split cone sequence to its Hom cone, with the signed normalization fixed by S. Derived sections, exact inverse image and derived tensor preserve distinguished triangles. Transport the ringed-site exactness through the same constant-ring realization and normalized Hom comparisons to the two native composites leftSource/leftTarget and rightSource/rightTarget. This gives distinguishedness for the fixed S, not an unrelated existential shift structure.

Naturality from the existing transpose theorem gives the first two squares. At the connecting arrow d it gives B(d) lambda_at_shift = lambda A(d). Shift by one and substitute the shift equation of the second step: this is exactly the third triangle square, with the same opposite rotation sign on each side. Set all three components to the specified native pairings, and repeat in the second coefficient.
